JOB OVERVIEW

The SharePoint / Microsoft 365 Specialist will administer, improve and progressively develop KOMIS's SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365 environment.

You will work on our SharePoint intranet, Hub architecture, departmental Team Sites, document management, permissions and automation, while also supporting colleagues with existing SharePoint solutions.

The role combines hands-on technical work with business-process understanding. You will work closely with the allocated KOMIS Manager, Project Managers and users to translate operational needs into practical and maintainable Microsoft 365 solutions.

For someone who enjoys both technology and problem solving, this role offers considerable scope to shape solutions and see the direct impact of their work across the organisation.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

SharePoint & Microsoft 365

• Administer, maintain and improve KOMIS's SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365 environment.
• Support Project Managers and users with existing SharePoint sites and functionality.
• Configure and progressively develop the SharePoint Online intranet and Hub architecture.
• Create and maintain departmental SharePoint Team Sites connected to Microsoft Teams.
• Configure Hub navigation, Quick Links, News templates and aggregated news.
• Troubleshoot SharePoint and Microsoft 365 issues and implement practical solutions.
Information, documents & access

• Configure document libraries, metadata, views and information structures.
• Support restructuring and migration of content from existing SharePoint sites.
• Manage Microsoft Entra ID security groups, permissions and access controls, including library-level permissions.
• Help maintain clear, secure and manageable access structures across SharePoint.
Automation & business solutions

• Develop SharePoint Lists and, progressively, Power Automate workflows and Power Apps where useful.
• Identify opportunities to simplify or automate recurring business processes using Microsoft 365 tools.
Business support, testing & documentation

• Work with managers and users to understand business needs and translate them into practical Microsoft 365 solutions.
• Test new configurations and solutions before deployment.
• Document configurations, procedures and solutions and prepare user guidance where needed. 
QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS

We are looking for someone who combines solid Microsoft 365 knowledge with a practical and solution-oriented mindset.

You should have:

• At least 3 years of practical professional experience with SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365.
• Solid knowledge of SharePoint sites, document libraries, permissions, metadata, views and Hub Sites.
• Experience integrating SharePoint Online and Microsoft Teams.
• Good understanding of Microsoft Entra ID, security groups and access management.
• Practical experience with SharePoint Lists and Power Automate.
• Ability to understand business processes and translate them into Microsoft 365 solutions.
• Strong troubleshooting, documentation and communication skills.
• Good written and spoken English.
NICE TO HAVE

Experience with any of the following would be an advantage: Microsoft Power Apps; Microsoft Graph; PowerShell or PnP PowerShell; SharePoint governance; SharePoint migration tools; Microsoft 365 security and compliance; Broader Microsoft Power Platform solutions.

You do not need to bring all of these from day one. We are particularly interested in candidates with a strong SharePoint/Microsoft 365 foundation, sound judgement and willingness to develop further.
 
WHY JOIN US

This role offers the opportunity to have a visible impact on how KOMIS collaborates, manages information and uses technology across the organisation.

We offer:

• A role with real ownership and scope to shape solutions.
• The opportunity to develop a modern SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365 environment.
• Exposure to different teams, business processes and international projects.
• A collaborative environment where initiative and practical ideas are encouraged.
• Brussels-based hybrid working arrangement.
At KOMIS, we value practical solutions, continuous improvement and people who take ownership of their work.

Are you at the beginning of your career and motivated by learning new things and developing in a professional environment? We are looking for a structured and curious person who wants to build experience in project administration, coordination and communication.

At Mercuri Urval (MU), a leading international company in Executive Search and Leadership Advisory, you will have the opportunity to become part of our office in Brussels (office location will be Zaventem as from December 1st). We work with market-leading clients and important assignments where quality in every detail is crucial. You will be part of a team where you receive a thorough introduction and continuous support, and where you gradually take on more responsibility as you develop. The role suits you who are newly graduated or have up to a couple of years of experience and want a varied day-to-day work with good development opportunities.
About the role
As a Business Support Specialist at MU, you have a central and business-critical role in the daily operations. Your work directly contributes to structure, quality and an efficient implementation of our client assignments. You will be part of a support team that collaborates closely across country and office borders. We value quality, knowledge sharing, clear communication and a non-prestigious way of working together, and you will have broad contact surfaces both locally and internationally.
Examples of tasks
• Assist with ongoing administrative work, project follow-up and coordination with support from colleagues
• Assist with administrative tasks related to contracts, invoicing and internal support
• Help with coordination and publishing of job advertisements in digital channels
• Support with proofreading, simple translation
• Opportunity to develop in the role and gradually take on more responsibility over time
To succeed in the role, you are highly structured, quality-conscious and confident in a professional context. You have the ability to maintain focus even at a high pace with several parallel tasks.
 You are a person who
• has some experience in administrative, coordinating or supporting tasks, for example from a role as administrator, coordinator, assistant or similar.
• enjoys creating structure, keeping track of details and making everyday life run smoothly for others.
• has an interest in administration, processes, systems and preferably also in how ways of working can be improved and made more efficient.
• feels comfortable with Microsoft Office and other digital tools, and is curious about how AI can be used as support in daily work.
• is comfortable engaging with individuals in senior-level positions, including C-suite executives and Board members.
• communicates clearly and professionally in Dutch, French and English, both orally and in writing.
• is service-oriented, meticulous and solution-driven, with a way of working that builds trust.
• has a proactive approach, thinks out-of-the-box and can set priorities independently.
• thrives when taking responsibility for tasks, working in a structured way and delivering with quality.
• wants to continue developing in a role where you can learn a lot, grow over time and contribute to a professional environment with high ambitions. Our offer
• Employment in a global and engaging environment that promotes collaborative teamwork, human values, and where working and interacting with people is enjoyable.
• The opportunity to work with a flat, foundation-owned company that is a leader in the field of science-based human resources management and leadership advisory, both nationally and internationally.
• A cross-border team of Business Specialist colleagues who prioritise collective success over hierarchical structures.
• A small local team of ~15 kind and dynamic consultants, and many more colleagues across the globe.
• A permanent full-time contract with a salary package and extra benefits that aligns with your experience and market standards.Application
If you can see yourself in the role as a Business Support Specialist at MU, we look forward to receiving your application and CV. If you have questions about the position, you are warmly welcome to contact +32 (0)2 715 09 99.

Your role

As a Senior Electrical Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in transforming innovative machine concepts into reliable, high-performance electrical systems. Acting as the technical owner of the electrical design, you will bridge project requirements and practical implementation, ensuring that every machine is engineered according to the highest quality and safety standards.

Your responsibilities

Electrical design and project planning

• Starting from the conceptual phase, you will participate in the project design meetings where you will collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams.
• You create realistic project schedules and contribute to the collaborative planning meetings in order to create a realistic project planning.
• After the concept phase, you will take ownership of the electrical descriptions: you will translate the draft electrical descriptions and specifications into clear and detailed guidelines for the electrical hardware design of the project.
• Based on these electrical descriptions, you will design and adjust the electrical drawings (Eplan P8).
• You will design the 3D electrical layouts in Eplan Propanel.
• You ensure all designs comply with the applicable standards and regulations (EN60204, MD, EMC, LVD, ...).
Execution and collaboration

• Once the design is finished, you create and update ERP work orders for the customer-specific projects and the masters for standard machines.
• During the assembly process you will follow up closely with production.
• As a senior, you will also develop, maintain, and continuously improve electrical design guidelines and best practices and ensure all designs comply with the applicable standards.
• You will support your colleagues when necessary and will collaborate with them to review schematics for accuracy.
• You contribute actively to departmental standardization initiatives and gradually take ownership of driving these improvements forward. 
Your profile

• You have a Masters degree in industrial sciences in Electromechanics or Electrotechnics or are equivalent by experience.
• You have at least 5 years of experience in Electrical engineering, preferably within the machine building industry.
• This means you have a solid knowledge of electrical standards. Knowledge of UL standards is a plus.
• You have good knowledge of Eplan P8. Knowledge of Eplan Propanel is a plus.
• You have an analytical mind and are a problem solver.
• You're a good communicator and a team player in an international environment.
• You have a good knowledge of English and Dutch. 
Our offer

• We offer you a challenging job in an international, collaborative and growth-oriented working environment.
• A technical engineering role with opportunities to lead improvement initiatives and to have an impact.
• A competitive compensation package complemented by attractive benefits such as a company car.

jobs.occupation: Senior Mechanical & Piping Project Engineer - Technical Lead
jobs.description:
📋 Tasks and responsibilities

This position centres on senior technical project engineering rather than administrative coordination or traditional project management. As Technical Lead on multidisciplinary CAPEX projects, you help develop and deliver solutions that are safe, feasible and maintainable within a controlled project setting.

You will work in an operational brownfield environment where safety, reliability, technical quality and minimal disruption to production are key considerations. The role combines specialist Mechanical & Piping expertise with a broad understanding of engineering, execution and handover activities.

Responsibilities

• Define and maintain the technical basis, design philosophy, project scope and battery limits.
• Coordinate engineering activities across disciplines, with Mechanical & Piping as the core area and close collaboration with process, E&I, automation, civil, safety and infrastructure teams.
• Plan and lead design reviews, assessing solutions against safety, compliance, functionality, reliability, maintainability, constructability and lifecycle value.
• Translate process and project requirements into Mechanical & Piping concepts and oversee the quality of layouts, P&IDs, equipment specifications, piping classes, routing and isometrics.
• Assess technical alternatives in terms of feasibility, safety, reliability and cost-effectiveness.
• Provide technical direction to engineering partners, suppliers and contractors, while critically reviewing their content, quality, planning and completeness of deliverables.
• Support technical decisions, document assumptions and deviations, and keep decisions and follow-up actions traceable.
• Identify technical and project risks and evaluate the impact of changes on scope, schedule, cost, execution and business continuity.
• Contribute to technical specifications, tender packages, bid evaluations, supplier selection and technical clarifications related to contracts.
• Follow up relevant Mechanical & Piping activities, including fabrication, inspections, FAT, delivery, installation, SAT and punch-list management through mechanical completion.
• Provide engineering support during construction, pre-commissioning, commissioning, start-up and handover.
• Assist the Project Manager with clear technical recommendations and transparent reporting to stakeholders.
• Coach engineers and help develop project engineering standards, methodologies, lessons learned and knowledge sharing.
Location

Olen, with 100% onsite presence.

Selection procedure

The selection process includes two interview rounds: an initial interview via Teams, followed by an on-site interview with a business case.

• You hold a master's degree in a technical discipline, or have reached an equivalent level through relevant experience. A background in electromechanics or chemical technology is particularly relevant.
• You have extensive experience in technical design and engineering in an industrial or process environment.
• You bring demonstrable specialist knowledge of Mechanical & Piping engineering within the process industry or another heavy industrial environment.
• You have proven experience with multidisciplinary CAPEX projects, from concept and basic engineering through execution and completion.
• You are able to provide technical direction to engineering partners, suppliers and contractors and critically evaluate their deliverables.
• You are familiar with applicable Mechanical & Piping standards and good engineering practices, including PED, ATEX and EN 13480.
• You hold a VCA-VOL certificate or are willing to obtain one before starting.
• Knowledge of AutoCAD Plant 3D is an advantage.
• You can work with project controls covering scope, schedule, costs, risks, changes and stakeholder management.
• You combine technical depth with a broad overview, decisiveness and a pragmatic approach to problem-solving.
• You explain complex technical topics clearly and collaborate effectively with different stakeholders.
• You work in a structured, autonomous and results-oriented way and demonstrate a strong sense of ownership.
• You communicate fluently in Dutch and professionally in English. Other languages are an advantage.

Do you enjoy precision shaping pipes and creating strong welds for technical installations? As a TIG or semi-automatic welder, you'll work on a variety of HVAC projects within the construction sector. You'll read plans, build custom installations, and weld pipes into perfect assemblies for heating and plumbing. Depending on the project, you'll work both on-site and in the workshop, preparing and assembling components. Thanks to the variety of high-end projects, your job remains technically challenging and educational. You'll be part of a large team where collaboration, quality, and safety are paramount.

What are your tasks?

• Reading and interpreting technical plans

• Bending, grinding, and welding pipes (TIG/semi-automatic)

• Preparing and assembling installations in the workshop and on-site

• Experience as a welder in a technical or construction environment

• Communicate in English or Romanian

• Possession of a driver's license
